disclaimer: Salary ranges are estimates compiled from public salary-report sources and job postings. They are not official statistics. Actual pay varies by city, employer, and skill level.

fields.name: Software Engineering
fields.notes: Remote and freelance work raises the ceiling beyond local pay scales

fields.name: Data Science
fields.notes: Fewer local openings than software — most roles sit in banks, telcos, and remote teams

fields.name: Medicine
fields.notes: House-job stipends are far lower; top consultants in private practice earn much more

fields.name: Dentistry
fields.notes: Govt posts start near PKR 100k; private clinics pay more as your patient base grows

fields.name: Civil Engineering
fields.notes: Salaries swing with project cycles — Gulf roles pay several times local rates

fields.name: Electrical Engineering
fields.notes: Power-sector and solar jobs dominate hiring

fields.name: Mechanical Engineering
fields.notes: Manufacturing and HVAC maintenance roles are the steady core of hiring

fields.name: Accounting & Finance
fields.notes: CA qualification roughly doubles pay versus a plain B.Com

fields.name: Business & Marketing
fields.notes: Digital marketing and e-commerce roles pay above traditional FMCG starts

fields.name: Law
fields.notes: First years pay little; earnings jump once you build a case record or join a corporate firm

fields.name: Architecture
fields.notes: Small studios pay low; established firms and your own practice lift the ceiling

fields.name: Education
fields.notes: Govt jobs dominate entry level; private schools pay less but hire faster

careerPaths.name: Freelancing
pros: Earn in USD at international rates from anywhere in Pakistan
No degree gate — portfolio and skill win the work
Full control of hours and workload
cons: Income swings month to month — no fixed salary
No pension, medical insurance, or job security
You handle your own taxes and client disputes
careerPaths.bestFor: Self-disciplined students in tech, design, and writing — pairs well with university.

careerPaths.name: Government
pros: Permanent posts with pension and guaranteed yearly increments
Medical, housing, and utility allowances on top of basic pay
Respect, job security, and fixed working hours
cons: Promotions move slowly — seniority beats merit
Basic pay starts modest at lower BPS grades
Seats are few — thousands compete for one post
careerPaths.bestFor: Students who want lifelong stability and a respected post, and can commit to the exam grind.

careerPaths.name: Private
pros: Merit and results get you promoted fast
Skilled people can out-earn govt officers within a few years
Exposure to modern tools, training, and networks
cons: Little job security — layoffs come with every downturn
Long hours and constant pressure to perform
Benefits like pensions and medical cover vary wildly
careerPaths.incomeRange: PKR 30,000 – 600,000+/month depending on field, city, and employer
careerPaths.bestFor: Growth-focused students who can sell their skills and don't mind switching jobs for better pay.
